title: An Entomologist’s Improbable Toolkit
content: Mormolyce phyllodes, violin beetle, on Die Zauberflöte (The Magic Flute, 1791) by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Albert Einstein’s favorite composer. Illustration + photo collage by Barrett Klein; page of musical score from Berlin State Library and retrieved from the Library of Congress, www.loc.gov/item/2021667708/.
